purpose: Size the Leung_NMCNR_Pin_3 amplifier using the permitted parameters. Meet all eight fixed nominal DC, AC, and transient requirements within 30 evaluations. The joint requirements are project-defined for this released circuit adaptation.

design_context.circuit_description: Two nested compensation capacitors share node net044, connected through RESISTOR_0 to VOUT. No independent feedforward output PMOS parameter. Distinct nulling-resistor mechanism. Original Fig.7 correspondence reviewed. Leung variants must share a source-family split.
